description.text:
Eternal Birth (亘古开来) was the first Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 17 January 2025 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. With it the Chinese game moved from the Sword & Shield series to Scarlet & Violet. It brought the first cards with regulation mark G, and from the same day the Standard format allowed only cards marked E, F and G; Pokémon Tools also stopped counting as Items.

Eternal Birth introduced Pokémon ex, Basic or evolved Pokémon with strong attacks and high HP that give up two Prize cards when Knocked Out. The Legendary Pokémon Miraidon is at the center of its cover: Miraidon ex's Ability, Tandem Unit, puts up to two Basic Lightning Pokémon from the deck onto the Bench. Other ex include Koraidon ex, Absol ex, Tinkaton ex, Great Tusk ex and Iron Treads ex, and its Trainers include Giovanni's Charisma, Electric Generator, Bravery Charm and the Stadium Town Store. Common, Uncommon and Rare cards also come as Poké Ball pattern and Master Ball pattern holos. Packs also held a card for Miraidon items in the game Pokémon UNITE (宝可梦大集结). Its main cards are numbered out of 127; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 167.
